name: black-friday-deals (Pimjo)
accepts: 'AI tools, SaaS, apps, or developer and design tools.' iPhone, iPad and Mac apps with no-code deals are listed under Productivity Tools.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding one row at the end of the right category table in README.md, or the Google Form linked from the README.
entry_format: | [**Name**](url) | One-line description. | 30% OFF yearly plans (Coupon: `CODE2026`) | Nov 20 – Dec 2, 2026 |  (the README's own template row; merged rows vary: some bold the discount, some write 'no code needed', some give $old → $new)
rules: Submit only active or upcoming deals. Use official links, no third-party coupon sites. Include start and end dates when available.
Check for duplicates before submitting. Keep the existing order: first come, first served.
No CONTRIBUTING file, no pull request template, no per-maker limit. The maintainer merges in batches without comments.
README.md is saved with Windows line endings (every line on 20 Nov 2026). Keep them, or the diff touches every line.
status_note: 158 pull requests from outside authors merged since 1 Oct 2026, the latest on 19 Nov 2026; 51 open; 5 closed without a merge.
recommended_for: AI tools, SaaS, apps, developer and design tools; iPhone and Mac apps under Productivity Tools
